## ms2-sh v0.1.0

Turns a native resampler into a single importable `.sh` for **OpenUtau Mobile (Android)**. Import the result under *Options → Custom resamplers*.

### Usage (Termux)
```bash
pkg install git cmake make clang
cp ms2-sh $PREFIX/bin/ && chmod +x $PREFIX/bin/ms2-sh
ms2-sh                      # build moresampler2 and write ~/storage/downloads/moresampler2.sh
ms2-sh <git-url|folder>     # build another CMake project
ms2-sh <file>               # check a file; wrap it if it is a native ELF binary
```

### Good to know
- Native ELF binaries are wrapped. A Windows `.exe` is rejected, since it can't become a script and Android can't run it directly.
- After building on the device, it runs the program once as a self-test and warns on exit code 159 (SIGSYS), 126, 127 or a crash signal.
- **Not confirmed to work end to end.** Exit code 159 and a full render inside OpenUtau Mobile have not been verified.
- The default target is [moresampler2](https://github.com/Astel123457/moresampler2), which shows no license. Check it before redistributing built binaries.
